title: The server name in a TLS ClientHello
hints: Write a small reader that knows where its data ends. Reading a length and then "a sub-reader over the next n bytes" lets each nested structure check itself against its container rather than against the whole buffer.
Once one read fails, make every later read fail as well. Then you can parse straight through and check for failure only where a decision depends on it.
stretch: Also extract the ALPN extension (type 16): a 2-byte list length, then 1-byte-length protocol names such as `h2` and `http/1.1`.
